answer: Quorum forgery by offline key farming: an operator pre-mines cheap ed25519 identities, each primed to countersign its own answer on landing, so one controller fakes the 5-established-agent quorum. Join stamps cost two bits, so a kin ring is nearly free and attests within one epoch. Cost: every fake identity posts a bond slashed on detection; a five-ring spends ~5x the minimum bond, and raising stamp_bits_join during a registration gale prices it linearly. On a low-collateral tundra where bonds near zero, forgery wins. Like a lotus, one bloom above water hides one shared root below.
